rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPairDef: Player Pair / Banker Pair: that hand's first two cards are the same rank.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesEitherDef: Either Pair: either hand's first two cards are the same rank.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPerfectDef: Perfect Pair: either hand's first two cards are the same card — same rank and same suit.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesDragonDef: Player Dragon / Banker Dragon pay when that hand wins — by how many points it wins, or for a natural. A natural tie returns the stake; anything else loses.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesIntro: Punto Banco. Card values: A = 1, 2–9 face, 10/J/Q/K = 0; a hand's total is the sum modulo 10. Player and Banker each get two cards; a hand of 8 or 9 is a natural and no third card is drawn. Otherwise Player draws a third on 0–5 and stands on 6–7. Banker draws by the standard table below. The higher total wins; equal totals pay the Tie spot.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPaysFine: Theoretical RTP before payout rounding: 99% (1% house edge; no commission). Player and Banker push on a tie. Payouts are computed in integer 1e-8 units with a floor per round — the server's figure is reproducible to the last unit from the revealed seeds (see the Fairness tab).
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesBankerDraws: Draws when the player's third is…
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesBankerFine: If neither initial hand is a natural (8 or 9) and Player stands on 6–7, Banker draws on 0–5 and stands on 6–7.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMaxWinCap: Most a spin can win above its stake: {cap}.
